# SM-16 — AI on untrusted content

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** An LLM processes content from users or the web.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
Content delimited and treated as data; no side-effect tools unless allow-listed; model output never executed or rendered as raw HTML.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-16-L1** Untrusted content is passed in delimited data blocks; the model has no side-effect tools outside the allow-list; output is escaped. | auto + review | `review_verdict` |

## Full
Lite, plus an injection test corpus and a per-request token cap.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-16-F1** The injection corpus causes no tool call, data leak or rendered script; requests over the token cap are refused. | auto | `test_report` |
